text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—The ultimate form of victory that I 
desire.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That is to get ahead of El and seize 1st 
place in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe. 
While Sensei's life still holds out until 
next year.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Unless every condition is met, I will 
lose. The probability of winning would be 
nearly 0%.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —That's why I've got a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Shall we go, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Pardon me—whoops.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Taking a midday nap, Sensei?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha, look at you enjoying yourself. 
...Well then, I'm just gonna go ahead and 
talk.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Looking back on it, Sensei and I... we've 
known each other for quite a long time, 
haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: —Sensei was always ridiculously serious.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Even though there was no way she could 
ever catch up to us when we gave it our 
all, Sensei would just keep chasing after 
us forever."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...And then the next day, she gave me an 
absolute earful at school.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"If you love thrilling excitement that 
much, then try taking on a match where 
you're pushed even closer to the brink. 
With those legs of yours."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I enrolled. Into Tracen 
Academy. To compete on the razor's edge.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
To the stage where the greatest race 
unfolds... I have arrived.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
And she even teamed up with some eccentric 
Trainer who said, "We're gonna conquer the 
world together."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Doc.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Here's what I think. Gambling is all 
about making choices. A single choice can 
end up deciding your whole life."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
My hands back then will probably be 
sickeningly slick with sweat. Panicked, 
confused, lost. And then I—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—It makes me feel the worst, and the 
absolute best.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...So stay alive. And watch. Watch how I 
live my life."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Your hopes aren't gonna be crushed, not a 
chance.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, but if I open my eyes, I 
feel like the tears will start 
overflowing."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Former Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"Seriously... look at you, able to say 
such cool things now."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Now then, here we are at the venue for 
our battle— the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing left to say here, right, 
El? We have our legs to do the talking.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Nakayama-senpai. Please show me how 
much you've grown!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: If it's you, I know you can do it, yes!
